_comment: Model catalog ('bricks') for the RAM-aware composer. ramGB is an EDITABLE estimate of resident unified-memory footprint (weights + KV at the configured ctx) on a 128 GB GB10 node; tune against the live 'used' figure the composer shows. placement 'dual' occupies BOTH nodes (TP=2) and is exclusive. Each launch node uses {cmd,args} per action so a brick can start locally or over ssh.

models.notes: Single-node ds4 (Entrpi/ds4 fork v0.5.x, CUDA sm_121) serving the DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 IQ2XXS/Q2K GGUF (~81 GiB, in-RAM) + DSpark, ctx 200k. Runnable on either node (ds4-entrpi.sh present on both; gguf+drafter cached on both). Backend port 8000; clients reach it via the llama-swap gateway.
models.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 (GGUF, in-RAM) served by ds4 with DSpark speculative decode. Single node, 200k context.

models.notes: Single-node 0731 via MiaAI-Lab/DeepSeek-v4-Flash-One-DGX-Spark at ~/deploy/ds4-one (docker compose, vLLM 26.02 + SparkInfer kernels). EXL3 3.0bpw MCG/TR3 on a REAP-pruned K216 checkpoint (216/256 experts), ~99.5 GiB, native 432 B NVFP4 KV records, DSpark K5 spec-decode, 340k ctx at util 0.93 (KV pool ~348.8k tokens, 1.03x). Server default thinking is ON at effort max. NOT upstream's 384k/0.94: that claims 114.39 of 121.69 GiB and leaves only 7.30 GiB for a host whose baseline is ~6.0 GiB, so the kernel OOM-killed VLLM::EngineCore twice on 2026-08-26 right after KV sizing; util 0.935 yields only 380.2k tokens so 384k is unreachable at any safer util. See deploy/ds4-one.sh for the full arithmetic. TAKES THE WHOLE NODE: weightGB is pinned at sparkDash's 113 GB budget (121 cap - 8 reserve) to keep the brick composable as node-exclusive. Weights must be staged once before the first start (~107 GB, no GPU): ~/deploy/ds4-one/download.sh. Backend port 8000; clients reach it via the llama-swap gateway. Served name is '-solo' so it never collides with the dual TP=2 brick, which also serves on :8000.
models.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 (EXL3 3.0bpw, REAP-K216) served by vLLM + SparkInfer with DSpark K5 speculative decode. Single node, 340k context, ~44-47 tok/s decode.

models.notes: NVFP4 + DFlash spec-decode (ENABLE_SPEC=1), ctx 256k, util 0.80. MEASURED: weights 69.3 GiB (incl. drafter) + ~2.4 overhead + >=9.2 GiB KV for one 256k request => 81 GB floor (util >=0.67); ~8.6 min to load. Backend port 8002 (unique so it can co-reside with other single-node models; clients reach it via the llama-swap gateway).

(elastic KV — auto-sized to gpu-memory-utilization, so footprint scales and the declared floor stays honest). Backend port 8004 (moved off 8000 so it can co-reside with entrpi/dual). models.notes: 0731 model (deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731) NVFP4 + DSpark spec-decode, TP=2 over RoCE, ctx 1M. Whole-cluster (both nodes). vLLM via ~/deploy/dspark (upstream MiaAI-Lab/DeepSeek-v4-Flash-DSpark-2x-DGX-Spark, now a git checkout - upgrade with git pull) using .env.dspark.0731 (project deepseek-v4-flash-0731), pinned to DSPARK_REVISION=9e165c30. Cached on both nodes. To refresh: ENV_FILE=~/deploy/dspark/.env.dspark.0731 PREPARE_WORKER=0 ~/deploy/dspark/prepare-dspark-model-cache.sh --official --yes on spark1, then rsync the HF model dir to Spark2 over the fabric.

models.notes: MiaAI-Lab GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3/TR3 4bpw (~164 GiB, 120 shards) split TP=2 over the CX7 fabric: spark1 head (10.100.72.2) + spark2 worker (10.100.72.1), both on enp1s0f1np1/rocep1s0f1. DFlash2 speculative decode. Upstream 1.6+ profile (synced 2026-09-24): :exl3-instanttensor image with the InstantTensor loader (~70 s cold load vs ~300 s), 850k ctx at util 0.85 with an explicit 14 GiB KV pool (--kv-cache-memory-bytes; without it 0.85 does not boot on the loader), fair v5 mixed-prefill, MNBT 7168. weightGB 104 = 0.85 x 121.69 GiB. Deployment tree at /home/eric/deploy/glm53 (own .env + overlay), so it is NOT vendored into deploy/. Backend port 8888.

models.notes: jeff (github.com/logan-markewich/jeff) serving knowledgator/gliformer-large-v1 (400M) as a self-hosted TypeSafe jev System One API. NOT a chat model: it answers classification questions (choice / score / noul) on POST /v1/systemone and has no /v1/chat/completions, so "gateway": false keeps it out of llama-swap - clients point TYPESAFE_BASE_URL straight at port 8006. MEASURED on spark1: 2719 MiB GPU (bf16, torch backend), ~7 s load + 1.4 s warmup, 24-25 ms per 3-question request; weightGB pinned at 3 with no maxUtil (fixed footprint - no elastic KV), so it co-resides with anything leaving 3 GB. Its /v1/models requires a bearer key, hence ready.endpoint /healthz. Keys are read from ~/.jeff-api-keys by deploy/jeff.sh, never from this file.
models.description: jeff System One API (GLiFormer-large-v1, 400M). Text classification - choice, score and noul questions over the TypeSafe jev wire format. 20k char state limit.

models.notes: MiaAI-Lab Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Single-DGX-Spark-TensorFold @364f21a in ~/deploy/qwen38-single on BOTH nodes (.env: PORT=8007). TensorFold Zig engine (tensorfold-qwen38:zig-db28187), INT4-AutoRound checkpoint azampatti/...@1464274 (~122 GiB), FP8 KV, vision on, 262k ctx, PARALLEL 8, MTP drafts. Needs ~92 GiB MemAvailable to start and then sizes its KV pool from MemAvailable minus 10 GiB, so it takes the WHOLE node: weightGB 104 until a measured peak replaces it (model-stats.json). Upstream: ~64 tok/s single stream, ~201 aggregate at 8. start.sh returns once LIVE; stop.sh removes the container. wholeNode: its KV cache grows into free memory while serving (to MemAvailable minus 10 GiB), so a measured idle peak must never shrink its claim.
models.description: Qwen3.8 Flash Next (125B-A5B, INT4-AutoRound) on one Spark with TensorFold: MTP drafts, image + video input, 262k context.
